system.description:
Watching a subject with intense concentration, you perceive the shifting halo of colour that surrounds all creatures, reading their emotions, motives and true nature. The scrutiny is obvious — others can see you staring.

You must be able to see the target. Spend a turn in concentration and make a Static Mental Challenge against the target's Mental Traits (more complex beings are harder to read); because this is a Static Test, the target may not relent or retest. On a success, ask any one question, which the subject must answer truthfully: their current mood, what sort of creature they are, whether they are under any form of magic, whether they have committed diablerie, or whether the last thing they said was a lie. Aura Perception also lets you sense the pale, flickering auras of nearby ghosts and astral forms (a normal challenge, expending a Mental Trait), though not enough to identify specific individuals.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
